fileName.description: Exact basename of handler modules, e.g. route.ts.

filePattern.description: Regex tested against the posix path relative to cwd; alternative or addition to fileName.

sinks.description: Function names that write an audit row, matched by name.

sinkModules.description: Modules whose named exports count as sinks when called.

callerSuppliedAction.description: Sinks that take a caller-supplied action and so still need a prefixed literal.

namespacingSinks.description: Sinks that apply the namespace themselves.

tableInserts.description: Table identifiers for which x.insert(<table>) counts as a sink.

actionPrefixes.description: Action string prefixes that count as namespaced.

prefixConstants.description: Identifiers that, opening a template literal, count as a prefix.

allowMarker.description: Marker text that exempts a handler when inside a justified block comment.

baseline.description: Path of the committed baseline file.

guidance.description: Project-specific lines printed under a failure.
